Rae (Partnerships): Quick thread to finalize the partner-orbit scrub for marketplace launch. Need: final embargo time, partner asset handoff, hardware badge placement, and on-call rota for first 6h.
Omar (Marketing): Proposed embargo 2026-06-10 15:00 PT (22:00 UTC). Partners asked for APAC-friendly publish slots; suggest partner blogs staggered T+6h, T+10h, T+14h.
Nina (Platform): Cutover plan: 90m window with canary 5% -> 25% -> full. DNS TTL = 60s during window. CDN edge purge after promote.
Kofi (Eng): We'll add circuit-breaker for partner tiles and lazy-load video. Need partner video by T-48h. Also request 2h pre-cutover code freeze.
Sara (Legal): Trademark and quote approvals due 48h pre-embargo. EdgeWorks needs JP/KR translation signoff if APAC slot used.
DeployBot: Scheduled job created for epoch 1728686400 (operator scheduled).
Rae (Partnerships): Action items: Omar collect signed quotes; Nina publish runbook link; Kofi prep feature-flag gating; Sara get translations queued. Quick sync 11:00 PT?
Omar (Marketing): 11:00 PT works. I'll send invites and the partner asset ZIP tonight. :thumbsup:
